articles.title: Why is Elon Musk plotting a mega-merger of SpaceX and Tesla?

events.summary: Elon Musk proposed merging SpaceX and Tesla, asserting there is significant value in combining the two entities. The proposed transaction would stand as the largest corporate merger in history.
events.why: A consolidation of this magnitude would dramatically alter the aerospace, automotive, and capital markets globally.

articles.title: Is Ebola under control in Kenya after nine cases confirmed?

events.summary: Nine cases of Ebola have been confirmed in Kenya, prompting the US to advise reconsidering travel to the country. The Kenyan government is working to reassure the public that the situation is being managed.
events.why: An outbreak of a high-fatality pathogen in a major regional hub poses significant epidemic and biosecurity risks.

articles.title: Houthi missile strike on Yemen camp kills 73 security recruits, local authorities say

events.summary: A Houthi missile attack on a government-controlled training camp in Shabwa province killed 73 security recruits. Three missiles struck the Yemen army facility on Monday.
events.why: Represents a high-fatality strike in the Yemeni conflict that disrupts security forces and risks escalating regional warfare.

articles.title: Borneo burning: Life on the frontline of South East Asia's toxic haze

events.summary: Months-long fires fueled by a 'Super El Niño' in Indonesia have generated toxic haze across Southeast Asia. The environmental disaster has sickened hundreds of thousands of people.
events.why: Presents a massive transboundary public health and ecological crisis impacting multiple Southeast Asian nations.

articles.title: Exiled critic of Rwandan president found beheaded

events.summary: Former Rwandan army sergeant major Robert Kabera, an exiled critic of the Rwandan president, was found beheaded in Uganda. Kabera was a singer and YouTuber who had sought asylum.
events.why: Signals a potential transnational assassination targeting political dissidents and threatens regional relations between Rwanda and Uganda.

articles.title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting bug had Saudi support, claims prosecutors

events.summary: Former OpenAI worker Abdulrahman Alfozan has been denied bail after being accused of planting a recording device. Prosecutors allege he received support from Saudi Arabia.
events.why: Highlights nation-state espionage and corporate infiltration targeting foundational artificial intelligence labs.

articles.title: Deadly fire at Canada military base moved a kilometre 'in 30 to 60 seconds'

events.summary: A fast-moving fire at a Canadian military base killed four men and injured dozens of others. Accounts report the blaze advanced approximately one kilometre in 30 to 60 seconds.
events.why: Deadly incident on a national defense installation resulting in military casualties and rapid infrastructure hazards.

articles.title: Seventh day of violent clashes between Albanian protesters and police

events.summary: Nearly 300 people, including more than 150 police officers, have been injured during seven consecutive days of anti-government protests in Albania. Demonstrations show no sign of subsiding.
events.why: Severe civil unrest and clashes threaten national political stability and internal security.

articles.title: Mission blasts off for Mars to grab a piece of its moon

events.summary: A spacecraft is scheduled to launch on a mission to retrieve 10 grams of dust from a Martian moon and return it to Earth.
events.why: Advancing planetary science and sample return capabilities provides insights into the formation of the solar system.
